verdict.rationale: Fellow publishes a per-endpoint Developer API reference covering recordings, action items, notes, authentication, pagination and webhooks. However, nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive, such as a 'try it' console or runnable request examples. The OpenAPI probe found no public spec at any candidate path, so a static reference is all that is evidenced, which is adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
